dedupe_keys.name: hong kong 1 1000 water mains record plans wsd pipe network gis

description: The 1:1000 Water Mains Record Plans are the digital record of Hong Kong's water supply network produced by the Water Supplies Department (WSD), covering the whole Hong Kong SAR since 1997. The vector dataset is an ArcGIS geodatabase with edge-junction topology that holds pipe alignments of the fresh, salt and raw water systems with main type, diameter, material, distribution region and owner, plus valves, fittings, waterworks installations and other apparatus, on a Lands Department base map. Coverage is all of Hong Kong. The data are copyrighted by WSD and for its internal use, but can be provided on request to government departments, utility undertakers and other parties with a genuine need, as geodatabase or DWG on disc or as paper plans, at the charges WSD publishes; the base map is not released and data cannot be passed on without WSD's written agreement. Caveats: access is restricted and paid, and WSD states that alignments are indicative only and should be checked on site where positional accuracy matters. Simulation uses: a full-city pipe network with materials and diameters for hydraulic network flow, cascading failure and hazard exposure studies. Related records: the WSD open data on reservoirs, supply and bursts (data-hong-kong-wsd-open-data-reservoirs-supply-bursts).
